faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the BITS Pilani Project Assistant position is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application is sent well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Sc. degree in Microbiology or Zoology, or a B.Tech. degree, or an equivalent qualification. Prior experience in microbiology and molecular biology is advantageous.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000 plus 9% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Assistant in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the BITS Pilani located?
faq.answer: BITS Pilani is located in Pilani, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Who should I contact if I have further questions?
faq.answer: For any further queries, it is recommended to refer to the official notification or contact the BITS Pilani administration directly through the provided contact details.
